name: simplan-ado-extension
description: simplan Azure DevOps extension (front end). Bundled with esbuild into dist/, packaged with tfx.

scripts.package: node build.js && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.package:dev: node build.js && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file overrides.dev.json --output-path out
